<subject>Re: Need to pay COFHP invoice by COB Tues 11/25.    NOTICE OF COFHP MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO COFHP IS OVERDUE</subject>
<body>
Alain -- My understanding was that Lumière Santé had satisfied COFHP's accreditation requirements last week; however, below is a notice that the invoice has not been paid and Lumière Santé will not be able to participate in COFHP network services if the bill is not paid by 11/25 COB.

Please let us know if Santé Rhône Auvergne needs to call COFHP to try to discuss this.  Jacqueline 04 72 38 51 69.
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Cousin, Richard
Sent: Wed 11/19/2025 9:20 AM
To: Guilbert, Jacqueline; Robin, Philippe
Cc: Boulay, Hugues; Laine, Emmanuel
Subject: FW: Santé Rhône Auvergne MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO COFHP IS OVERDUE

FYI

-----Original Message-----
From: d992@cofhpcorp.com [<mailto:d992@cofhpcorp.com>]
Sent: Tuesday, November 18, 2025 8:43 PM
To: helene.pruvost@lumieresante.fr; victor.hoarau@lumieresante.fr
Cc: d742@healthnetlabs.com; l184@healthnetlabs.com
Subject: Santé Rhône Auvergne MEMBERSHIP AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th
PAYMENT TO COFHP IS OVERDUE
Importance: High

> This is your formal notice that COFHP now considers your organisation in breach of
> the COFHP Membership Agreement for non-payment of your November 5, 2025 COFHP
> invoice by 1 p.m. today. In accordance with the current provisions of Section
> 15.1.3 of COFHP's Membership Agreement, you have three business days to rectify
> this breach by making full payment to COFHP. If this breach is not rectified by
> the end of COFHP's business day on Tuesday, November 25, 2025, COFHP will declare
> your organisation in default and terminate your rights to participate at COFHP
> committee meetings, to transact business in COFHP's referral networks, and to receive
> clinical affiliation services from COFHP. Additionally, all COFHP Members will receive a
> list tomorrow of organisations that did not pay their invoice for October activity
> on the due date.
>
> If you have any questions regarding this notice or the amount your organisation
> owes to COFHP, please contact Margot Ferreira at +33 4 19 32 69 07 or Olivie Le Roux at
> +33 4 71 47 75 05.
>
> Suzanne Daugherty
> Controller
</quoted>
